powers.title: Battle Fury Stance
powers.description: You throw your full weight into each attack, ruining your defenses but scoring a crippling blow with each strike.
rows: Effect: You gain a +2 power bonus to damage rolls with weapon attacks but suffer a -2 penalty to AC. The bonus damage from this stance increases to +4 at 11th level and +6 at 21st level.
Special: This stance ends when you spend a healing surge. You can end this stance as a free action during your turn but not on the same turn that you activated it.

powers.title: Battle Leader
powers.description: Your leadership experience lets you enable nearby allies to move safely through combat.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Diplomacy.
Target: Each ally in the burst
Effect: Each target can shift 1 square as a free action.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 133.

powers.title: Boundless Endurance
powers.description: You shake off the worst of your wounds.
rows: Effect: You assume the boundless endurance stance. Until the stance ends, you have regeneration while you are bloodied. The regeneration equals 2 + your Constitution.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 78, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Close the Gap
powers.description: As your foe falls, you quickly move on to challenge a new enemy.
rows: Trigger: An adjacent enemy marked by you drops to 0 hit points
Effect: You move a number of squares equal to your Dexterity. You can mark one enemy that is adjacent to you after this movement. The mark lasts until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Create Opening
powers.description: You draw your enemy's attention, allowing an ally to slip away.
rows: Target: One creature

Effect: The target is marked until the end of your next turn. The target can then make a melee basic attack against you as a free action, with a –2 penalty to the attack roll. One ally adjacent to the target can shift its speed as a free action.

powers.title: Crowd Fighting
powers.description: You roll with your foe's feeble attack, causing it to lash out at another nearby enemy.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Society.
Trigger: An enemy misses you with a melee attack.
Target: One creature other than the triggering enemy
Effect: The target takes damage equal to 3 + your Dexterity.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 156.

powers.title: Defensive Stance
powers.description: Dropping into a cautious stance, you maneuver around your opponent's attacks to get into position.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you are slowed and gain a +2 power bonus to AC. Whenever an enemy misses you with a melee attack, you can shift 1 square as an immediate reaction. You can end this stance as a free action.

powers.title: Forceful Drag
powers.description: You dig your fingers into a foe and drag the struggling opponent across the battlefield.
rows: Requirement: You must have a creature grabbed.

Effect: You move your speed. For each square you move, you slide a creature grabbed by you 1 square to a square adjacent to you. The creature remains grabbed, and you do not provoke an opportunity attack from the grabbed creature for this movement. At the end of the move, you can end the grab to knock the creature prone.

powers.title: Full Extension
powers.description: You lunge forward, hitting a spot well beyond where your foes thought you could reach.
rows: Effect: The reach of the next melee weapon attack you make before the end of your turn increases by 1.

powers.title: Get Over Here
powers.description: You pull one of your allies into a more advantageous position.
rows: Target: One ally
Effect: You slide the target up to 2 squares to a square adjacent to you.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 78, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Glowering Threat
powers.description: Your intimidating presence distracts your enemies as they attempt to attack your allies.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Intimidate.
Target: Each enemy in the burst
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, each target takes a -5 penalty to attack rolls against any creature other than you.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 133.

powers.title: Mighty Leap
powers.description: You gather your strength for a truly impressive jump.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your turn, you gain a +5 power bonus to Athletics checks to jump. In addition, any jump you make is considered to have a running start, and you can make an Athletics check instead of an Acrobatics check to reduce falling damage.

powers.title: Minor Resurgence
powers.description: Your ability to withstand hardship grants you a temporary boost in combat.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Endurance.
Requirement: You must be bloodied.
Effect: You gain 5 temporary hit points.
Level 11: 10 temporary hit points.
Level 21: 15 temporary hit points.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 133, 156.

powers.title: No Opening
powers.description: You raise your weapon or shield to block an opening in your defenses.
rows: Trigger: An enemy attacks you and has combat advantage against you.
Effect: You don't grant combat advantage for the attack.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 78, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Pass Forward
powers.description: With perfect timing, you slip by your foe without dropping your guard.
rows: Effect: You pick an adjacent enemy and move up to your speed. As long as you end this movement in a square adjacent to that enemy, your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks from that enemy.

powers.title: Push Forward
powers.description: Through careful timing and balanced footwork, you avoid your enemies' attacks as you advance.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Athletics.
Effect: You shift up to 3 squares to a square adjacent to an enemy.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 134.

powers.title: Quick Escape
powers.description: You quickly try to shake off whatever's holding you.
rows: Effect: You make an escape attempt, or you make a saving throw against an effect that immobilizes or restrains you and that a save can end.

powers.title: Shielded Sides
powers.description: You whirl with your shield, concentrating on closing any holes in your defenses.
rows: Requirement: You must be using a shield.
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +2 power bonus to AC and Reflex and do not grant combat advantage to creatures flanking you.

powers.title: Shielding Shove
powers.description: You shove an ally out of harm's way with your shield.
rows: Requirement: You must be using a shield.
Target: One ally
Effect: You push the target 3 squares. Then you can mark an enemy adjacent to you until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Shrewd Repositioning
powers.description: An enemy's attack lands, but you spot a way to better your tactics.
rows: Trigger: You are hit by an attack
Effect: You can shift a number of squares equal to your Wisdom.

powers.title: Sidestep Maneuver
powers.description: The enemy closes to strike, but you duck away and ready a nasty counterstrike.
rows: Trigger: An enemy ends its move in a square adjacent to you.
Effect: You shift 3 squares to a square adjacent to the triggering enemy. You gain a +2 power bonus to your next attack roll against the triggering enemy before the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Dark Sun Campaign Setting, page(s) 87.

powers.title: Single Out
powers.description: Your fury in battle causes a nearby foe to quake with fear.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Intimidate.
Target: One enemy
Effect: The target grants combat advantage to you until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 156.

powers.title: Snagging Grip
powers.description: When you're knocked off balance, you grab hold of the enemy in front of you and bring it staggering along with you.
rows: Trigger: An enemy adjacent to you knocks you prone or forces you to move
Target: The triggering enemy in the burst
Effect: If the target forced you to move, you can pull it to a square adjacent to you. If the target knocked you prone, you knock it prone.

powers.title: Sudden Sprint
powers.description: You put on a burst of speed as you launch yourself toward a foe.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Athletics.
Effect: You move a number of squares up to your Dexterity to a square adjacent to an enemy.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 157.

powers.title: Unstoppable
powers.description: You let your adrenaline surge carry you through the battle.
rows: Effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to 2d6 + your Constitution.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 78, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Who's Next?
powers.description: When the foe crumples, you move forward to find your next opponent.
rows: Requirement: You must have reduced a nonminion enemy to 0 hit points during this turn.
Effect: You shift up to your speed and gain a bonus to your next damage roll made before the end of your next turn equal to the number of squares you moved from your starting position.

powers.title: Agile Approach
powers.description: You make a quick shift to a better position.
rows: Effect: You can shift 2 squares and must end adjacent to an enemy. If you aren't wearing heavy armor, you can shift 3 squares.

powers.title: Battle Awareness
powers.description: You can sense danger before the threat is fully realized.
rows: Trigger: You roll initiative and dislike the result.
Effect: You gain a +10 bonus to your initiative check.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 80, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Bodyguard's Stance
powers.description: You stand poised, ready to block attacks made against your allies with your shield or, failing that, your body.
rows: Effect: Whenever an ally adjacent to you takes damage, as a free action reduce that damage by 5. You must use this ability anytime you are able. When you do so, you take 5 damage; this damage that can't be reduce of redirected in any way.
Special: You can end this stance as a free action during your turn.

powers.title: Daring Shout
powers.description: You challenge nearby enemies to attack you, bolstering your own stamina.
rows: Target: Each enemy in the burst you can see.
Effect: The target is marked until the end of your next turn. You gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution + the number of targets in the burst.

powers.title: Dauntless Endurance
powers.description: You easily shake off a debilitating effect that would cripple another warrior.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Endurance.
Trigger: You make a saving throw and dislike the result.
Effect: You can reroll the saving throw but must use the second result.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 135.

powers.title: Defensive Training
powers.description: With a soldier's discipline, you fend off attacks that would overcome a lesser person.
rows: Effect: You assume the defensive training stance. Until the stance ends, you gain a +2 power bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 80, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Get Up!
powers.description: The aid you provide gets a dying ally back on his or her feet.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Medicine.
Target: One dying ally
Effect: The target can spend a healing surge. He or she can then stand up as a free action.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 158.

powers.title: Helping Hands
powers.description: Your stalwart presence helps fortify an ally you reach out to.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Medicine.
Target: One ally
Effect: The target makes a saving throw.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 135.

powers.title: Ignore Weakness
powers.description: A surge of inner strength helps you shrug off the lingering effects of your enemy's attacks.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Endurance.
Trigger: You start your turn immobilized, slowed, or weakened by an effect that a save can end.
Effect: You make a saving throw with a +5 power bonus against the effect.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 158.

powers.title: Intimidating Reminder
powers.description: Just the sight of your shield keeps the memory of its use fresh in the minds of your enemies.
rows: Requirement: You must be using a shield.
Effect: Until the stance ends, enemies take a -2 penalty to Fortitude while adjacent to you.

powers.title: Kirre's Roar
powers.description: You let out an explosive roar, diverting your enemies' attentions to you. The call steels you against the imminent assault.
rows: Target: Each enemy in the burst
Effect: You mark each target until the end of your next turn. In addition, you gain resistance to all damage equal to your Dexterity until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Dark Sun Campaign Setting, page(s) 87.

powers.title: Knight's Challenge
powers.description: You point your weapon at your enemy. Its allies look at it expectantly, as it wavers between accepting your challenge and losing face before its friends.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Intimidate.
Target: One enemy in the burst whose Will is equal to or lower than 12 + your level
Effect: You pull the target up to 2 squares. You cannot pull the target into hindering terrain.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 135.

powers.title: Line Breaker
powers.description: You turn aside your enemies' attacks as you advance across the battlefield.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Athletics.
Effect: You move up to your speed. During this movement, you gain a +5 power bonus to all defenses against opportunity attacks.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 158.

powers.title: Line in the Sand
powers.description: You trace a line on the ground with your weapon, daring your enemies to cross it.
rows: Requirement: You must be proficient in Intimidate.
Target: One creature
Effect: The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of the encounter or until you leave the zone. Any enemy inside the zone grants combat advantage to you.

powers.title: Makeshift Shield
powers.description: You snatch a piece of furniture, a body, or a discarded item to block an enemy's attack.
rows: Requirement: You must have a hand free.
Trigger: An enemy hits you with a close or a melee attack
Effect: You gain a a bonus to defenses against the attack equal to your Dexterity modifer.

powers.title: Rapid Advance
powers.description: Your physical training lets you surge quickly across the battlefield.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Athletics.
Effect: You move a number of squares up to your speed + your Constitution.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 136.

powers.title: Ready to Retaliate
powers.description: You hold your weapon high overhead, ready to swing at any foe that attacks you.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you can use a free action to mark any enemy that makes a melee attack against you. The mark lasts until the end of the enemy's next turn.

powers.title: Rejoin the Fray
powers.description: Reinvigorated by an ally's healing, you rush back into the fray.
rows: Trigger: An ally uses a healing power on you
Effect: If you are prone, you stand up and shift 1 square. If you are standing, you instead shift 3 squares.

powers.title: Rock Steady
powers.description: You sink your center of gravity into the ground below you and grit your teeth. You are going nowhere.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you cannot be knocked prone, and if you are subject to a pull, a push, or a slide, you can reduce the forced movement by 1 square.

powers.title: Settling the Score
powers.description: When the attack hits you, you decide then and there to take your enemy out.
rows: Trigger: An enemy hits you with an attack
Effect: You gain a +2 power bonus to attack rolls against the triggering enemy until the end of the encounter.

powers.title: Strong Focus
powers.description: Concentration improves your ability to accomplish feats of strength.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a power bonus to Athletics checks and Strength ability checks equal to your Wisdom.

powers.title: Unbalancing Dodge
powers.description: You duck out of the way of your foe's attack, putting the creature off balance.
rows: Trigger: An enemy misses you with a melee attack
Target: The triggering enemy
Effect: The target takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls and all defenses until the end of its next turn.

powers.title: Unbreakable
powers.description: You steel yourself against a brutal attack.
rows: Trigger: You are hit and damaged by an attack.
Effect: The damage against you is reduced by 5 + your Constitution.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 80, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Veteran Gambit
powers.description: By recognizing your enemy's tactics, you effortlessly predict the foe's next move.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Society.
Trigger: An enemy hits you with a melee attack.
Effect: You gain a +2 power bonus to all defenses against the triggering enemy. The bonus lasts until the end of the triggering enemy's next turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 158.

powers.title: Vigilant Protector
powers.description: You sweep your shield out to give your allies protection.
rows: Requirement: You must be using a shield.
Effect: Until the stance ends, you take a –1 penalty to AC and Reflex, but each ally gains a +2 power bonus to AC and Reflex while adjacent to you.
Special: If you are a dragonborn, your adjacent allies instead gain a +3 power bonus to AC and Reflex.

powers.title: Another Day
powers.description: After suffering a hit, you leap out of your opponent's reach to escape any subsequent attacks.
rows: Trigger: You are hit by an attack.
Effect: You shift your speed + 4.
powers.source: Published in Dark Sun Campaign Setting, page(s) 88.

powers.title: Battlefield Healing
powers.description: Your attention enables a comrade to draw on his or her own reserves of healing.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Medicine.
Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target can spend a healing surge.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 137.

powers.title: Body Shield (Fighter)
powers.description: You yank a foe into the path of an enemy's attack.
rows: Trigger: An enemy hits you with a melee or a ranged attack
Requirement: You must have a hand free.
Target: One creature other than the triggering enemy
Effect: Make a grab attack against the target. If you grab the target, the triggering enemy's attack deals half damage to you and half damage to the target.

powers.title: Clearheaded
powers.description: Your mental resilience and training let you shake off an effect that hinders you.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Endurance.
Trigger: You start your turn dazed, dominated, or stunned by an effect that a save can end.
Effect: You make a saving throw with a +5 power bonus against the triggering effect.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 160.

powers.title: Defensive Advance
powers.description: As you advance toward a chosen foe, you confound all attempts to attack you.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Athletics.
Effect: You gain a +2 power bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn, and you shift up to your speed to a square adjacent to an enemy.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 138.

powers.title: Defensive Resurgence
powers.description: You buck up under the pressure and redouble your defensive efforts.
rows: Effect: You can spend a healing surge. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a bonus to AC equal to your Dexterity.

powers.title: Fearsome Threat
powers.description: The threat you pose is enough to set your enemies on edge, giving you and your allies a temporary advantage.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Intimidate.
Target: Each enemy in the burst
Effect: Each target grants combat advantage until it hits or misses you or until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 138.

powers.title: Fighter's Grit
powers.description: With pure determination, you ignore weakness and battle on.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you ignore the effects of the dazed, immobilized, slowed, and weakened conditions.

powers.title: Fist of Lightning
powers.description: You clench your fist and prepare a rapid assault.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, your unarmed attacks deal extra damage equal to your Dexterity.

powers.title: Grappler's Stance
powers.description: You wrench the limbs of your enemy, weakening its resolve.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, any creature grabbed by you is restrained until the grab ends.

powers.title: Grim Presence
powers.description: Your frightful presence forces your enemies back.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Intimidate.
Target: Each enemy in the burst whose Will is equal to or less than 12 + your level
Effect: You can push each target 1 square.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 160.

powers.title: Hold Your Ground
powers.description: You demonstrate your physical superiority by resisting a foe's attempt to move you.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Athletics.
Trigger: You are pulled, pushed, slid, or knocked prone.
Effect: You are not pulled, pushed, slid, or knocked prone.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 160.

powers.title: Hunker Down
powers.description: You drop into a defensive posture, raising your shield to protect yourself.
rows: Requirement: You must be using a shield.
Effect: Until the stance ends, you are slowed, but you gain cover against all attacks. You can end this stance as a free action.

powers.title: Into the Fray
powers.description: You scream a fierce battle cry as you leap boldly into the fray.
rows: Effect: You move up to 3 squares, but only if you can end the move adjacent to an enemy.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 81, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Iron Defiance
powers.description: You draw on your inner strength to resist even the deadliest effects.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Endurance.
Trigger: You take damage.
Effect: You take only half of the triggering damage.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 138.

powers.title: Last Ditch Evasion
powers.description: Through skill and luck, you narrowly avoid an attack but leave yourself perilously exposed.
rows: Trigger: You are hit by an attack.
Effect: You take no damage from the attack, but you are stunned and take a -2 penalty to all defenses until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 81, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Martial Redoubt
powers.description: You sink into a broad fighting stance, whirling your weapon in an arc that disrupts your foe's line of sight and allows you to knock aside your enemy's attacks. While you protect your foes, this stance forces you to compromise your own defenses.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, your allies have cover when adjacent to you. Your enemies gain combat advantage against you.
Special: You can end this stance as a free action during your turn.

powers.title: Menacing Stance
powers.description: You seem ready to spring at any moment, forcing marked foes to devote more attention to you.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, whenever an enemy marked by you makes an attack that doesn't include you as a target, that enemy grants combat advantage to your allies until the start of its next turn.

powers.title: Mighty Surge
powers.description: You dig deep to find the strength you need to overcome your foes.
rows: Effect: You can spend a healing surge, and you also gain a +2 power bonus to all defenses and a +1 power bonus to attack rolls until the end of your next turn. Until the end of the encounter, each time you spend a healing surge, you gain a +2 power bonus to all defenses and a +1 power bonus to attack rolls until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Phalanx Leader
powers.description: You gather your allies behind your shield's bulwark, and their presence gives you the upper hand.
rows: Requirement: You must be using a shield.
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, while any ally is adjacent to you, that ally gains a +2 shield bonus to AC and Reflex and you gain a +2 power bonus to melee attack rolls.

powers.title: Shield Deflection
powers.description: Attacks rebound from your shield to find new targets.
rows: Trigger: An attack against your AC or Reflex misses you
Effect: Choose a creature within 2 squares of you and within range of the triggering attack, including the triggering attacker. The attacker repeats the attack against that creature.

powers.title: Shooter's Nemesis
powers.description: The fact that your enemy is too cowardly to close to melee swells your confidence.
rows: Trigger: You are hit by a ranged attack
Effect: You spend a healing surge and regain additional hit points equal to twice your Wisdom.

powers.title: Stalwart Guard
powers.description: You focus your attention on guarding your allies' backs.
rows: Effect: You assume the stalwart guard stance. Until the stance ends, allies gain a +1 shield bonus to AC while adjacent to you. If you are using a shield, allies instead gain a +2 shield bonus to AC and Reflex while adjacent to you.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 81, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Steely Persuasion
powers.description: Your skill with the blade is enough to daunt even stalwart foes.
rows: Trigger: You make an Intimidate check or a Society check
Requirement: You must be wielding a melee weapon.
Effect: You gain a bonus to the skill check equal to the weapon's proficiency bonus plus the weapon's enhancement bonus.

powers.title: Strength from Pain
powers.description: The pain of your wounds opens the floodgates to your inner strength.
rows: Requirement: You must be bloodied.
Effect: You gain a +4 power bonus to melee damage rolls, Athletics checks, and Endurance checks until the end of the encounter or until you are no longer bloodied.
Special: If you are a dragonborn, you instead gain a +5 power bonus.

powers.title: Temporary Relief
powers.description: With a healer's focus, you look past the pain that plagues you.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Medicine.
Trigger: You take ongoing damage at the start of your turn.
Effect: You do not take the ongoing damage this turn. In addition, you make a saving throw against the ongoing damage, with a +5 power bonus.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 161.
